verse.verse_1: TRULY WE REVEALED it on the Night of Determination.
verse.verse_2: How will you know what the Night of Determination is?
verse.verse_3: Better is the Night of Determination than a thousand months.
verse.verse_4: On (this night) the angels and grace descend by the dispensation of their Lord, for settling all affairs.
verse.verse_5: It is peace till the dawning of the day.
